lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a regular grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately five distinct horizontal rows across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured checkerboard-like pattern of anchor nodes along the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible; a central midline carinae and two parallel lateral ridges, each characterized by a high-intensity luminance highlight on the dorsal edge and a deep shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, with larger spots concentrated near the base and smaller spots toward the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a distinct transition from a high-density dusting of small punctate spots to a vermiculated pattern of thin, high-luminance lines connecting larger blobs at the transition to the trunk.
